lines.text: This is Baton. Here's *everything it can do*, one feature at a time.
Bring free AI keys from Gemini, Groq or OpenRouter, or *your own server*.
On *Automatic*, every task goes to the model that suits it, and if one hits its limit, the next takes over.
Chat has five modes: *general, study, work, research and code*.
Switch on *Team*, and six helpers split a big question and work at the same time.
It doesn't just talk. It has *58 real tools*:
Google and Microsoft 365 with Excel, any mailbox, GitHub, databases, the web and PDFs, and *Slack or Teams*.
Connect Google or Microsoft in one click, and Slack or Teams channels with a webhook.
Your keys are encrypted, and *never reach the AI*.
Build an agent *just by chatting*: say what it should do, and when.
It runs on a schedule, and a readiness check shows *what's missing* before it ever runs.
The Agent Tree shows each agent at a glance: *what starts it*, its stages, the tools it uses, and what you get.
Every tool has one setting: *always allow, ask me first, or blocked*.
Reading runs on its own, sending asks first, and posting to a channel *starts blocked*.
When a step needs your yes, the run *pauses and waits*.
Approve it in the app, *from your email*, or from Slack.
Baton *remembers* what you tell it, and you can read or forget anything.
History keeps *every run*, step by step.
And Models and cost shows what each model did, and *what the free tiers saved you*.
Press the mic to *speak instead of typing*.
And new people get a short *welcome tour*.
For the team that runs Baton, a staff console shows *counts, never your chats*.
Baton. *Pass every task to the right AI.*
